fields.text: Same locked shot, three materials. Muse paints a glass look; Muse Edit restyles it to watercolor, then to photoreal fantasy; Seedance 1.5 Pro animates a material morph from the glass still. Camera and composition stay fixed. Inspired by ComfyUI style-morph / material-ladder clips (e.g. @eikoung).

A small translucent glass lighthouse filled with stacked books and a warm golden lantern, standing on wet black rocks in misty teal water under a pale crescent moon, clear glass walls with soft gold filigree, reflections on the water, fixed wide eye-level camera, centered composition, soft cinematic lighting, no people, no text, family-friendly SFW.

Restyle this exact scene as a soft hand-drawn watercolor illustration on textured paper. Keep the same lighthouse shape, book stacks, lantern, rocks, moon, and camera framing. Flat gentle washes, visible paper grain, ink outlines, muted teal and warm gold. No photoreal glass, no 3D render look, no people, no text overlays, SFW.

Restyle this exact scene as a photoreal cinematic fantasy photograph. Keep the same lighthouse silhouette, books, lantern glow, wet rocks, crescent moon, and locked camera framing. Real materials: weathered stone lighthouse, warm practical lantern light, misty teal sea, sharp detail. No cartoon, no watercolor paper, no people, no text overlays, SFW.

Locked camera. The lighthouse materials slowly morph from clear translucent glass and gold filigree into soft watercolor paper illustration, then settle. Same composition the whole time. Gentle mist only. No camera move, no new objects, no people, no text, SFW.
